description: The Democratic staff of the House Committee on Oversight and Reform, Subcommittee on Government Operations, is seeking an energetic and self-motivated graduate student for a full-time internship for Fall 2021. description: The Office of Congresswoman Debbie Wasserman Schultz is looking for interns to join our office for the Fall 2021 semester.
